interior_gamma_extension.domain: 0<=k,l<=n, interpreted through the Gamma/digamma extension before restricting to integer lattice points
interior_gamma_extension.derivation: Differentiate the Gamma-product logarithm of T. On the interior, psi(m+1)=H_m-gamma and psi1(m+1)=zeta(2)-H_m^(2); the Euler/zeta constants cancel in the displayed differences.

nested_weight_decomposition.consequence: The nested-coordinate part of E_D is E[A]*N11 + E[Lk]*N12k + E[Ll]*N12l; all increments of N11/N12k/N12l are one-body.

differentiated_qrow_certificates.base: L_BZ[T]=Delta_k(Rk)+Delta_l(Rl), with Rk=Reg[rho*T], Rl=Reg[sigma*T] away from shell specialization

for_A.generic_field_simplification: J*_A=T*(partial_k partial_l certificate - Ll*partial_k certificate - Lk*partial_l certificate)

differentiated_qrow_certificates.reason: L_BZ has coefficients depending only on n, and continuous partial derivatives commute with the k/l shift differences on the interior Gamma extension.

abel_transfer.principle: For each nested basis element N and coefficient certificate E[f]=Delta_k Jk+Delta_l Jl, summation by parts transfers the differences from J onto N. Since every Delta_k/Delta_l of N11, N12k, and N12l is one-body, the interior nested sector is reducible to the one-body sector plus boundary/shell terms.

shell_blocker.why_interior_is_not_global: The protected discrete target uses finite H(m<=0)=0 values on shifted support shells, whereas Lk/Ll as coordinate derivatives of the Gamma extension have poles there. The differentiated certificate therefore cannot be substituted on shell points without a separate reconciliation proof.

exact_representative_derivative_witness.conclusion: partial_k rho_sym has an exact cubic pole at the first k-shell

shell_blocker.consequence: The generic-field simplification T*partial_k(rho_sym) can retain a simple shell pole. No differentiated-flux boundary claim is admitted until the combined regularized discrete shell values are constructed explicitly.

next_exact_obligation: Construct shell-corrected differentiated Q-row fluxes for offsets 1,2,3 in both orientations, prove their finite discrete values and outer-boundary cancellation, then Abel-transfer N11/N12k/N12l to a purely one-body residual. If that closes, only the one-body residual remains for final telescoping/recurrence certification.
